intro.what: Biz kelajak haqida gapirish uchun 'will' va 'going to' zamonlaridan, shuningdek birinchi shart gaplardan foydalanamiz. Ushbu qoidalar rejalashtirilgan ishlar, taxminlar va shartli vaziyatlarni ifodalashga yordam beradi.
when: Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan ishlar va tezkor qarorlar uchun 'will' ishlatiladi.
Aniq reja va niyatlar uchun 'be going to' ishlatiladi.
Ko'zlangan dalillarga asoslangan kelajakdagi voqealar uchun 'be going to' ishlatiladi.
Kelajakdagi taxminlar uchun 'will' yoki 'going to' mos keladi.
Real shart-sharoit va uning natijasini ko'rsatish uchun First Conditional ishlatiladi.

structures.label: Will (Darak gap)
structures.example_en: I will help you with your homework.

structures.label: Be going to (Darak gap)
structures.example_en: We are going to visit Samarkand this summer.

structures.label: First Conditional
structures.formula: If + present simple, subject + will + verb
structures.example_en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
structures.example_uz: Agar yomg'ir yog'sa, biz uyda qolamiz.

structures.label: Will (So'roq gap)
structures.example_en: Will you come to my birthday party?

structures.label: Be going to (So'roq gap)
structures.example_en: Are you going to buy a new phone?

rules.title: Tezkor qarorlar uchun 'Will'
rules.text: Gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qarorlar uchun 'will' so'zi ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
It is cold. I will close the window.

rules.title: Rejalar uchun 'Be going to'
rules.text: Oldindan o'ylangan rejalar va niyatlar haqida gapirganda 'going to' ishlatiladi.

examples.en: I am going to study English tonight.
examples.uz: Men bugun kechqurun ingliz tilini o'qimoqchiman.

examples.en: She is going to buy a red dress.

rules.title: Aniq dalillar bilan taxmin qilish
rules.text: Atrofimizda ko'rib turgan narsalarimiz asosida kelajakni taxmin qilsak, 'going to' ishlatamiz.

examples.en: Look at those dark clouds. It is going to rain.
examples.uz: Anavi qora bulutlarga qarang. Yomg'ir yog'moqchi.

examples.en: He is running fast. He is going to win the race.
examples.uz: U tez yuguryapti. U poygada g'alaba qozonmoqchi.

rules.title: First Conditional tuzilishi
rules.text: Shart qismida hozirgi zamon (Present Simple), natija qismida esa 'will' ishlatiladi.

examples.en: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If she misses the bus, she will be late.
examples.uz: Agar u avtobusdan qolib ketsa, kechqoladi.

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain, I will stay at home.
mistakes.right: If it rains, I will stay at home.
mistakes.why: First conditional qoidasiga ko'ra, 'if' qismida 'will' ishlatilmaydi, faqat Present Simple ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I go to buy a new laptop tomorrow.
mistakes.right: I am going to buy a new laptop tomorrow.
mistakes.why: Kelajakdagi shaxsiy reja uchun 'be going to' kerak, shunchaki 'go' fe'li yetarli emas.

mistakes.wrong: She will visit Tashkent next week, she has ticket.
mistakes.right: She is going to visit Tashkent next week, she has a ticket.
mistakes.why: Chipta allaqachon olingan bo'lsa, bu aniq reja hisoblanadi va 'going to' ishlatiladi.

mistakes.wrong: I drop this bag, I help you.
mistakes.right: I will help you with that bag.
mistakes.why: Vaziyat taqozosi bilan qilingan yordam va'dalari yoki qarorlar uchun 'will' ishlatiladi.
